name: Zarethan
brief: A place near the Jordan River associated with Israel's crossing
short: Zarethan, a place near Adam and the Jordan River, mentioned in connection with Israel's crossing and the casting of bronze implements for Solomon's Temple (<ref="Josh. 3:16; 1Kgs. 4:12; 7:46; 2Chr. 4:17; Judg. 7:22">Josh. 3:16; 1Kgs. 4:12; 7:46; 2Chr. 4:17; Judg. 7:22</ref>).
